messages:
leo_finance: FYI — AWS Marketplace rebate for partner acct 554433 shows as $0 on the channel invoice for July but our internal rebate calc is $9,750. Looks like rebate lines are present in AWS export but not linked to reseller account. Anyone seen this pattern?

mike_billing: Pulling the raw CSV now. Obs: rebate rows have a new `rebate_reference` column and our join logic only matches on `invoice_item_id`. Sample: 
```
invoice_id,invoice_item_id,partner_id,amount,rebate_reference,reseller_account
inv-20260731,item-778,554433,9750,ref-RBT-332,
```

anya_revops: :thinking_face: AWS mentioned adding rebate_reference in their July feed. Our ETL probably treats empty reseller_account as non-reseller and drops rebate attribution. @mike_billing can you try a fallback join using partner_id+rebate_reference?

aws-billing-bot: AWS Marketplace notice: "Introduced rebate_reference column for programmatic rebate linking" (automated). See https://aws.example/marketplace/announcements/rebates (bot).

mike_billing: Will run fallback join. If we can reattribute, delta = $9,750. If not, we need to credit partner or request AWS adjust invoice. Creating ticket BILL-4987 and a PR to update join logic.

partners_ops: Partners will expect timely fix. Recommend manual credit if reingest can't be completed before next payout. Please include partner contact in the ticket.

leo_finance: I approve manual credit up to $10k for this specific partner to avoid payout delays. Record approval in finance-approvals.

anya_revops: Approved as well. Mike, schedule reingest and post results here. Also add a one-time ledger code for manual rebate corrections.

mike_billing: Reingest scheduled 2026-08-03 03:15 UTC. If reingest succeeds we'll void the manual credit. Posting results after reassembly.

leo_finance: Thanks. If reingest fails, please prepare credit memo and route to Legal for sign-off.
